title: FrameflowEditPlan
description: Claude's keep/remove decisions over a transcript. `reason` is required on every decision: the whitepaper's first-cut philosophy requires uncertain creative choices to stay visible to the creator, which is impossible if cuts arrive unexplained. `confidence` makes that visibility machine-readable, so a review UI can filter for the decisions worth checking rather than parsing prose.

reasoning.description: Optional human-readable summary of the overall approach.

confidence.description: Optional; absent means high. Mark a decision "low" when you are not sure it is right, and say why in `reason`. Applies to removals as well as keeps - an uncertain cut is the one the creator most needs to check, because the material is no longer on the timeline to notice. Deliberately not a third action: `action` stays keep/remove so that code which branches on it cannot silently drop uncertain material.
